console.label: Console
console.summary: React console for overview, field, history, decisions and economics; it reads the prepared JSON showcase.

jarvis.label: Jarvis
jarvis.summary: Visual console assistant: receives a question with screen context, calls domain tools, and shows answers with sources and cards.

web.label: Static server and proxy
web.summary: The HTTP server serves the built frontend and showcase while proxying Jarvis API requests to the separate service.

jarvis-service.label: Jarvis service (8010)
jarvis-service.summary: Separate dialogue HTTP service that manages sessions, requests, SSE events and tool calls.

llm.label: Model client
llm.summary: The server-side client supports OpenRouter, Anthropic and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; provider and model are configuration choices.

search.label: Schedule search
search.summary: Candidate search builds schedules for a case; the fast surrogate helps score candidates, while an accepted result gets a separate verification.

surrogate.label: Fast reservoir model
surrogate.summary: The surrogate scores responses for candidates inside its supported region; its prediction does not replace OPM verification of a selected schedule.

policy.label: Agent hierarchy
policy.summary: Numerical policy makes field → group → well decisions using rules R0–R7 and records a trace when enabled for the run.

physics.label: Physical invariants
physics.summary: Checks evaluate response invariants and violations; simulator completion and schedule admissibility are reported separately.

economics.label: Economics and NPV
economics.summary: The economics context calculates NPV from cash flows, normatives and a base year; the methodology document explains the formula.

opm.label: OPM Flow
opm.summary: OPM Flow simulates the selected deck. A successful OPM run alone does not mean the schedule passed constraints.

deck.label: The Model_Z deck
deck.summary: The deck defines the reservoir input model; availability of source deck files depends on the deployment data bundle.

cases.label: Cases and constraints
cases.summary: A case stores limits and the origin of each constraint: organizer requirement, diagnostic value or our assumption.

runs.label: Runs
runs.summary: A run stores its identifier, schedule, prediction, simulation and checks; decision claims are tied to artifacts from that run.

submission.label: Submission package
submission.summary: The submission bundle links the schedule, verified result and input hashes; read the exact result from the built bundle.

webdata.label: JSON showcase
webdata.summary: The showcase context exports prepared JSON data for the console screens and Jarvis tools.

knowledge.label: Knowledge base
knowledge.summary: The glossary, screen guide and portable documents explain the product; when evidence is missing, the answer must state the gap.

docs.label: Project documents
docs.summary: The index searches current documents and historical sources; snapshots and archives are labeled and do not establish current behavior.

console->web.label: static files and the JSON showcase

console->jarvis.label: the question and the screen context

jarvis->llm.label: a request carrying the tool descriptions

search->policy.label: setpoints from rules R0 to R7

surrogate->physics.label: the response fed to the seven invariants

search->runs.label: schedule and prediction into the run directory

runs->opm.label: the same schedule sent for verification

opm->runs.label: the verified NPV and the violations

opm->economics.label: the simulator response for the methodology

runs->submission.label: the submission package with its hashes

policy->webdata.label: the hierarchy and the decision journal
